QuestInfo.name: [Celestial] Surging with Power
QuestInfo.0:
#e<Celestial Surge>#n

The solar eclipse is here, transforming day into night--and with it, comes a surge of mysterious energy!

Fill up the gauge and activate the Celestial Surge skill to accumulate #bincreasingly powerful EXP buffs#k! Talk to Dark Prince to learn the Celestial Surge skill.

#b* You must select #eCelestial Surge#n as your weekly event to utilize this skill.#k
